text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v2026.03.23-canary. Automated post-deploy smoke started across canary zones. apac2 synth probes showing elevated 504s on /embed route, p95=1.4s -> 504s spike.

alice.lopez: ack, seeing similar in dashboard. link: https://console.redwood/smoke/apac2/embed

devon: any change in model variant or quantization for this rollout?

deploy-bot: Model variant pinned: redwood-open-embed-v2.1.3-quant. No quant change in this deploy. Canary traffic %: 10% apac2.

sre_jamie: can we grab a quick curl to reproduce? if 504s are proxy backpressure or kv warmup.

maggie: tagging release notes: v2026.03.23 includes embed route perf patches and batching tweaks. if apac2 is regressing we should pin to previous commit.

alice.lopez: repro script: ```
curl -i -X POST https://apac2.api.redwood/embed -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json" -v
```

alice.lopez: ran locally, intermittent 504s ~1/8 requests. logs show upstream 502->504 from inference-proxy with kv cache misses.

devon: suggest immediate pin to redwood-open-embed-v2.1.2 in apac2 only, keep other regions rolling. fallback plan A: pin variant + increase concurrency limit on proxy, Plan B: rollback canary entirely.

oncall-bot: alert created: INC-2026-03123 - apac2 embed 504 spike. paging sre_jamie.

sre_jamie: I can take the paging. I'll start a synthetic replay against the previous variant and current variant (small batch) and compare latencies + 5xx traces.

maggie: if replay confirms regression, approve partial pin. tag @devon for pin-out.

devon: starting pin job: ``kubectl set image deploy/embed-proxy embed-proxy=registry/redwood/embed-proxy:v2.1.2-canary-pin`` only in apac2 pool. will monitor for 3m.

alice.lopez: thanks. will keep smoke watch on apac2 dashboards and post samples. :thumbsup:

sre_jamie: early results (2m): p95 down to 180ms, 5xxs -> 0/200. Looks like pin cleared the spike.

alice.lopez: confirmed, synth 100 rps run green.

maggie: decision: hold global rollout, keep apac2 pinned to v2.1.2. update release notes and docs with regression note. create follow-up RFC for batching change validation.

deploy-bot: Canary hold applied, apac2 pinned to v2.1.2. Notifying release-owner.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-03123 updated: status -> mitigated (apac2 pinned). Closing pending postmortem and follow-up evaluation.
